name: T5 OpenAPI search + execute
title: Find endpoints in GitHub's 13.9 MB OpenAPI description, then call them
description: Cloudflare's code-mode MCP pattern: the OpenAPI spec stays behind search/listOperations/getOperation tools and a request tool executes calls. The program must find the community-profile and list-releases operations (the search ranks lookalikes above them for some queries), fill the path templates, and call the real GitHub API. Real spec (github/rest-api-description, MIT) and real API replies.
prompt: You can call the GitHub REST API, but you don't know its endpoints: search its OpenAPI description first, then call the endpoints you find. For the repository BurntSushi/ripgrep, report (1) its community profile health percentage and which of these community files are missing: code_of_conduct, contributing, issue_template, pull_request_template, license, readme; (2) for its 3 most recent releases (the API's default order, 3 per page), the tag name, the publish time and the total download count over all release assets. Return JSON: {healthPercentage, missingFiles: [...], releases: [{tag, publishedAt, downloads}]}.

search.description: Keyword search over the operations of the GitHub REST API OpenAPI description (1254 operations). Ranks by matches in summary, operationId, path, tags and description.
search.outputDescription: {query, total, results: [{operationId, method, path, summary, description, tags, score, parameters: [{name, in, required, description, schema}], responses: {status: description}, documentationUrl}]}

listOperations.description: List every operation (operationId, method, path, summary, tags), optionally only those with a tag.

tag.description: Only operations with this tag, e.g. repos.

getOperation.description: Get one operation from the spec with all $refs resolved: parameters, requestBody and response schemas.
getOperation.outputDescription: {operationId, method, path, summary, description, tags, parameters, requestBody?, responses: {status: {description, content}}, ...}

request.description: Execute a read-only request against the GitHub REST API (https://api.github.com). Only GET is allowed. Path parameters must already be filled in.

path.description: Path with parameters filled in, e.g. /repos/octocat/hello-world.

request.outputDescription: {status, body} where body is the parsed JSON response.

source.data: real: GitHub REST API OpenAPI description (spec.json pins commit and sha256; MIT) served by spec.ts, and api.github.com replies captured by capture.ts
source.programs: model-written by Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) from prompt + api.d.ts; variants from a second model to be added
